other.content: PRIVACY FLOOR (current behavior, not an at-rest guarantee). Field.sensitivity is a per-field classification carried through the schema: validated on local ingest (apps/server/src/host/local-ingest.ts) and remote import, where the review gate applies the user-approved classification to imported fields (apps/server/src/host/connectors.ts), and surfaced in the UI and in assistant/MCP field descriptors. It does not gate persistence today: row data at rest is per-project and unencrypted, and apps/server/src/host/data-fetch/materializer.ts persists source and result Arrow through DataFrameStorage without a sensitivity check. ParquetCache (packages/engine-server/src/parquet-cache.ts) is a dormant capability, not constructed in production; its own write gate admits only explicitly cleared columns. A stricter data-at-rest floor is a future consideration. What IS enforced: never persist raw sample values in analysis JSON. packages/convex-backend/convex/host.ts strips sampleValues before imported-frame metadata and operation records are persisted (covered by the strips-samples case in packages/convex-backend/test/drafts.test.ts); flag any path that persists sample values or raw rows outside DataFrameStorage.

DESTRUCTIVE-RECOVERY rule (invariant). Any path that quarantines, deletes, or overwrites a user's local datadir must require POSITIVE evidence of the specific failure it recovers from — never infer it from a broad error signal. For PGlite WAL recovery: the torn-WAL-segment probe is the sole sufficient signal; an abort message alone (e.g. Aborted(OOM)) is NOT sufficient and must rethrow, not quarantine. Fail toward preserving data: when corruption cannot be positively confirmed, surface the error instead of destroying the datadir.

NO PER-SURFACE UI FORKS (invariant). The web and Electron renderers are IDENTICAL. No `isElectron` branches in components; capability differences ride through providers/context (the providerWrapper / engine-injection pattern), never component-level platform checks. Flag any `isElectron`/`window.electron` conditional inside a component's render.
NO OFF-TOKEN COLOR (invariant). No raw hex/rgb/oklch in classNames or styles. Use @wystack/ui semantic tokens only (neutral-*, palette-*, surface-*). Any off-token color is a finding.
NO RAW RUNTIME ERRORS IN USER-FACING UI (invariant). Never surface Emscripten/WASM/stack strings in dialogs, toasts, or banners. Translate to a human sentence plus a recovery action.

NO TICKET IDS IN SOURCE (CI-enforced). Source code and comments must never contain YW-/TASK- identifiers. Reference the public GitHub issue number (#nn) instead. This is checked by scripts/check-no-ticket-refs.mjs.
